description: What a fix-and-flip term sheet request needs, before you make one: every field, which are required, and the accepted values; the scope (a business-purpose fix-and-flip loan to buy and renovate a non-owner-occupied 1–4 unit investment property); and what the investor gets back. Read-only: nothing is priced, stored or sent. Fix-and-flip loans close in an LLC or corporation; it can be formed before closing. Every request, purchase or refinance, needs the property's full street address: number, street, city, state and ZIP. Reviewer mode: a request whose email address is at example.com, example.org or example.net, or at a .test or .invalid domain, is priced and answered in full with a download link, but nothing is emailed and no lead is recorded.
name: fix_and_flip_term_sheet_requirements
title: Fix-and-flip term sheet requirements
